summary: The solution implements a thorough modelling pipeline with solid feature engineering, text processing, and cross-validation. However, it suffers from critical data leakage because imputation, frequency encoding, TF-IDF extraction, and SVD are all performed on the concatenated train and test datasets before splitting. Furthermore, it relies on a single metric (RMSE) for evaluation.
